## Summary
Generate dual embeddings (MedCPT 768-dim + text-embedding-3-small 1536-dim) for all ContentChunk nodes and store them in Supabase pgvector with HNSW indexes.

## User story
As a platform engineer, I want each content chunk embedded with both a biomedical-specialized model (MedCPT) and a general-purpose model (text-embedding-3-small), so that downstream retrieval can leverage domain-specific and general semantic similarity.

## Why this matters
Single-model embeddings miss either biomedical precision (general models) or natural language fluency (domain models). The dual-embedding approach enables Reciprocal Rank Fusion in E03-S09, combining both signal types for TEACHES edge creation. Without quality embeddings, entity extraction and TEACHES edges will have poor recall.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] MedCPT embeddings (768-dim) generated for all ContentChunk nodes
- [ ] text-embedding-3-small embeddings (1536-dim) generated for all ContentChunk nodes
- [ ] Embeddings stored in Supabase pgvector with HNSW indexes (m=16, ef_construction=200)
- [ ] Supabase written FIRST with embeddings, Neo4j node updated with has_embedding flag (Rule 6)
- [ ] Batch embedding calls use Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] SpeakerNote nodes also embedded (separately, not mixed with ContentChunks)
- [ ] Pipeline status updated to 'embedded' after completion
- [ ] Embedding cost stays under $0.005/chunk (both models combined)

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Enable pgvector extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

-- Embeddings table (dual vectors per chunk)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content_chunk_embeddings (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  content_chunk_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES content_chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  medcpt_embedding vector(768) NOT NULL,
  openai_embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- HNSW indexes for fast similarity search
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_medcpt_hnsw ON content_chunk_embeddings
  USING hnsw (medcpt_embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 200);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_openai_hnsw ON content_chunk_embeddings
  USING hnsw (openai_embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 200);

-- Speaker note embeddings (separate table — AP-11)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speaker_note_embeddings (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  speaker_note_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES speaker_notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  medcpt_embedding vector(768) NOT NULL,
  openai_embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p1-steps/multi-embed.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

const BATCH_SIZE = 50 // Process 50 chunks at a time

export async function multiEmbed(
  chunks: ContentChunk[],
  speakerNotes: SpeakerNote[],
  institutionId: string
) {
  const supabase = createServerClient()

  // Batch chunks for embedding
  for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = chunks.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE)
    const texts = batch.map(c => c.text)

    // Dual embed in parallel
    const [medcptResults, openaiResults] = await Promise.allSettled([
      embedMedCPT(texts),
      embedOpenAI(texts),
    ]).then(results => results.map(r =>
      r.status === 'fulfilled' ? r.value : null
    ))

    if (!medcptResults || !openaiResults) {
      throw new Error('Embedding generation failed for batch')
    }

    // 1. Write to Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
    const rows = batch.map((chunk, idx) => ({
      content_chunk_id: chunk.id,
      medcpt_embedding: medcptResults[idx],
      openai_embedding: openaiResults[idx],
    }))

    await supabase
      .from('content_chunk_embeddings')
      .insert(rows)

    // 2. Update Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
    await Promise.allSettled(
      batch.map(chunk =>
        neo4jQuery(institutionId, `
          MATCH (cc:ContentChunk { uuid: $uuid })
          SET cc.has_embedding = true
        `, { uuid: chunk.id })
      )
    )
  }
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E03/E03-S06.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'

test.describe('E03-S06: Multi-granularity embedding', () => {
  test('All chunks have dual embeddings in Supabase', async ({ request }) => {
    const chunksRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/chunks`
    )
    if (chunksRes.ok()) {
      const { data: chunks } = await chunksRes.json()
      for (const chunk of chunks) {
        const embRes = await request.get(
          `${API_BASE}/api/chunks/${chunk.id}/embeddings`
        )
        if (embRes.ok()) {
          const { data: emb } = await embRes.json()
          expect(emb.medcpt_embedding).toBeDefined()
          expect(emb.openai_embedding).toBeDefined()
          // MedCPT = 768 dim, OpenAI = 1536 dim
          expect(emb.medcpt_embedding.length).toBe(768)
          expect(emb.openai_embedding.length).toBe(1536)
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('Speaker notes have separate embeddings', async ({ request }) => {
    const notesRes = await request.get(
      `${API_BASE}/api/lectures/test-parse-001/speaker-notes`
    )
    if (notesRes.ok()) {
      const { data: notes } = await notesRes.json()
      for (const note of notes) {
        const embRes = await request.get(
          `${API_BASE}/api/speaker-notes/${note.id}/embeddings`
        )
        if (embRes.ok()) {
          const { data: emb } = await embRes.json()
          expect(emb.medcpt_embedding).toBeDefined()
          expect(emb.openai_embedding).toBeDefined()
        }
      }
    }
  })

  test('HNSW index supports similarity search', async ({ request }) => {
    // Test that we can do a nearest-neighbor query
    const res = await request.post(
      `${API_BASE}/api/chunks/search`,
      {
        data: {
          query: 'cardiac output stroke volume',
          model: 'medcpt',
          limit: 5,
        },
      }
    )
    if (res.ok()) {
      const { data } = await res.json()
      expect(data.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5)
    }
  })

  test('Negative: embedding dimension mismatch is rejected', async ({ request }) => {
    // Supabase vector column constraint should reject wrong dimensions
    // This is enforced by the vector(768) and vector(1536) column types
    expect(true).toBe(true) // Schema-level enforcement
  })
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS speaker_note_embeddings; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS content_chunk_embeddings;`
2. `DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_medcpt_hnsw; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_openai_hnsw;`
3. Neo4j: `MATCH (cc:ContentChunk) REMOVE cc.has_embedding`
4. `git stash && git checkout develop`
